scope: Native LP_LOG storage, byte-preserving query path, startup/grants validation and recovery of committed audit records in existing TLogSvrAsio

source_authority.original_wire: LogPacket.h: DWORD server/action/format; WORD map; int positions; eleven int64 search values; CHAR client IP[16], seven keys[50], payload[512]. Existing original Win32 header offsets retained.
source_authority.original_write: CUdpSocket::LogDBSave formats event timestamp to seconds and inserts original LT_* columns into ITEMLOGTLyyyymmdd, with WriteBlob of 512 bytes.
source_authority.original_chat: CUdpSocket.cpp:442-450 initializes all LP_COUNT entries to Packet_Nothing and only replaces LP_LOG with Packet_LogDB. LP_CHAT therefore follows source no-op; persistent chat logging is not established by this source. The modern decoder currently classifies non-LP_LOG as bad format; original-sender acceptance/classification remains unverified.
source_authority.history: No historical audit table or events invented; new empty application schema. The backups remain authoritative for the schemas they contain.

native_contract.raw_fields: lt_clientip and all seven lt_keyN are bounded bytea, without code-page interpretation; reader returns raw std::string; native startup display is hexadecimal.
native_contract.integer_fields: Unsigned wire DWORDs in constrained bigint; WORD map in constrained integer; signed int32 positions and int64 search keys.
native_contract.payload: Nonempty transmitted bytes preserved. Empty maps to NULL, retaining the existing modern contract; source legacy writes always used 512 bytes.
native_contract.metadata: Generated lt_id and database received_at are explicitly modern; original lt_logdate remains timestamp without time zone at original seconds precision.
native_contract.queries: Fully qualified configured table; native COUNT, ordered LIMIT, bound signed user filter. Custom table uses same validated contract and explicit grants. No native TOP/SpCall path.
native_contract.startup: Contract/version, exact relevant column types/nullability, INSERT and sequence USAGE checked; native startup read failure is fatal before UDP bind. Environment DSN is required when configured, with competing sources refused.
native_contract.permissions: Dedicated role has audit SELECT, INSERT only on source event columns, schema USAGE and identity sequence USAGE. No UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE/DDL or access to player account schema.
native_contract.outcomes: Prior committed/retryable/unknown boundary preserved. Unknown outcome closes its connection and is never blindly retried.
native_contract.retention: No automatic deletion policy or history import.

native_each.database: Real migrations 001-029 and real grant script with synthetic owned events; restricted runtime role and separate fixture owner.
native_each.upgrade: Apply preserved 001-028, insert account sentinel, apply only 029, verify row and all old receipts, run idempotently again.
native_each.faults: Exact COMMIT response loss after DB completion, INSERT disconnect, batch rollback, concurrent queue writers/drains, namespace shadow, missing column/type/INSERT/sequence privilege, private config source failures.
native_each.wire: Original-layout UDP with raw 50-byte non-UTF8 key and all 256 blob bytes; null payload; malformed datagram; periodic retry with responsive health endpoint.
native_each.recovery: Graceful restart reads committed rows; SIGKILL exit 137 and restart preserve three rows without replay; next UDP event persists. Does not test durability of volatile queued work.
native_each.release_scope: Installed Release Log daemon, verified Debug backend C++ test.
native_each.tls: Loopback plaintext only for deterministic fault proxy; prior pool TLS verification not repeated.

limits: Original executable/build/assets absent; no original-client acceptance or supported binary claim
Unknown commits have counters/diagnostics, not a durable reconciliation spool
Retry queue and Asio posted jobs are volatile; posted backlog not bounded here
Closed pool sessions still need process/pool replacement
Legacy code-page interpretation and historical audit imports unavailable
LP_CHAT source no-op versus modern classification and original tool acceptance pending
Retention policy and full external integrations unimplemented
Legacy ODBC/MSSQL integration fixtures absent; original ODBC mappings retained but not freshly executed
Independent Log change does not re-run the complete native gameplay matrix
policy: Local main commit and owned local containers only; nothing pushed or published.
